senses.gloss:
ऋद्धि, इस्, f. success, prosperity, good fortune,
affluence, increase, growth, accomplishment; perfec-
tion, supernatural power or supremacy; N. of a
medicinal plant; prosperity personified as the wife of
Kuvera; N. of the goddess Pārvatī.
—ऋद्धि-काम,
अस्, आ, अम्, desiring increase or prosperity.
—ऋद्धि-
मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, being in a prosperous state, pros-
perous, wealthy, respectable, rich; making a fine
appearance, bringing happiness.
—ऋद्धि-साक्षात्-
क्रिया, f. manifestation of supernatural power.
ऋद्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to prosper, prospered.
